# Fixture: synthetic transformer nameplate

Synthetic test fixture of the OCR sidecar (Story 8.3). No client material: the labels
are the seed's transformer nameplate labels, every value is invented.

Generated by `make_plate.py` (Pillow, DejaVu Sans from `fonts-dejavu-core`, no randomness).
Regenerate inside the image, never on the host:

```
docker compose --profile ocr run --rm --user "$(id -u):$(id -g)" \
  -v ./services/ocr/tests/fixtures:/app/tests/fixtures ocr python tests/fixtures/make_plate.py
```

- Image: `plate-transformador.jpg`, 1600 x 1100, JPEG quality 90, no EXIF
- sha256: `a1eac9106f186a29ca82e896741922794eda7f86a231c4dcf942031d14dc26ac`
- Expected tokens: `plate-transformador.tokens.json` (one per printed word, Pillow `textbbox`, reading order)

Header line: `TRANSFORMADOR DE FORÇA`.

| Label | Value | Field key | Kind |
|---|---|---|---|
| IDENTIFICAÇÃO | TR-01 | `identificacao` | text |
| FABRICAÇÃO | Celtta | `fabricacao` | manufacturer |
| Nº SÉRIE | 240815-07 | `n_serie` | text |
| TIPO | TSE-500/15 | `tipo` | text |
| TIPO DE ISOLAÇÃO | EPÓXI | `tipo_de_isolacao` | select |
| VOL. ÓLEO | 0 L | `vol_oleo` | number |
| POTÊNCIA NOMINAL | 500 kVA | `potencia_nominal` | number |
| TAP ATUAL | 3 | `tap_atual` | text |
| DATA FABRICAÇÃO | 08/2024 | `data_fabricacao` | date |
| TENSÃO NOMINAL AT | 15 kV | `tensao_nominal_at` | number |
| TENSÃO NOMINAL BT | 380 V | `tensao_nominal_bt` | number |
| LIGAÇÃO SECUNDÁRIA | Dyn1 | `ligacao_secundaria` | text |

`Celtta` is absent from the seeded manufacturer registry and `15 kV` is the voltage.
`VOL. ÓLEO 0 L` is a synthetic value chosen so every seed field prints one value.
